headline: Your meeting briefs got noticeably richer.

items.prompt_template: I fixed a drift where some content I extract from meetings wasn't making it into your briefs. From now on, your morning Upcoming Meetings brief includes a since-your-last-brief delta, decisions already on the record, and per-attendee tagging on talking points when 2+ people are in the room. Your evening Past Meetings brief preserves scope changes and financial details in the document, and the notes I append keep the deeper analysis — risks, opportunities, timeline, relationships — that was getting dropped. Your next scheduled fire picks up the new content automatically.
